routes.name: Sierra Leone eVisa
routes.summary: Online visa applications go through the official eVisa portal at evisa.sl. Eligibility, fees and processing times were not on the pages I could read.

other: Who needs a visa, visa-free nationalities, visa on arrival rules and fees were not confirmed. Check evisa.sl.

routes.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA)
routes.summary: An official ETA portal exists at eta.slid.datahub.gov.sl. The immigration site highlights it for travel to the West Africa Integration and Investment Summit on 16 to 18 November 2026. Whether it applies to other travelers is unclear.

other: Scope beyond the summit not confirmed.

routes.name: Work and residence permits (Unified Permit portal)
routes.summary: Work, residence, extension and re-entry permits are handled through the official Unified Permit portal at unifiedpermit.gov.sl.

other: Eligibility, fees, duration and routes to permanent residence or citizenship were not confirmed.
